meta.name: exploratory-data-analysis
meta.description: Perform bounded, local exploratory analysis of explicitly supported scientific files. Use for redacted CSV/TSV/JSON profiles; optional NumPy, HDF5, FASTA/FASTQ, and basic image metadata inspection; missingness/leakage audits; outlier and transformation sensitivity; and rigorous EDA report scaffolds. Other domain formats are reference-only and unknown formats fail closed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对科学数据进行探索性分析并生成报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速分析科学数据集并发现异常
copy.tagline_en: Perform exploratory analysis on scientific data and generate reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly analyze scientific datasets and detect anomalies

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先识别你给出的科学数据文件的类型，再按该格式做针对性分析（结构、质量、统计等），最后生成一份 Markdown 格式的 EDA 报告，包含发现和分析建议。
howto.when: 当你说要“探索”“分析”“总结”某个科学数据文件，或询问该文件适合做什么分析时触发。

say.text: 分析 reads.fastq 并生成报告
say.note: 它会对序列文件做长度、质量分数等检查。

say.text: 探索 experiment_results.csv，列出缺失值和异常值
say.note: 它会输出表格统计和发现。

say.text: 分析 cells.nd2 的维度和通道信息
say.note: 它会读取显微镜图像元数据并出报告。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude detects the scientific data file type, performs format-specific analysis (structure, quality, statistics), and produces a Markdown EDA report with findings and analysis suggestions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to explore, analyze, or summarize a scientific data file, or ask what analysis is appropriate for it.

say_en.text: Analyze reads.fastq and generate a report
say_en.note: It checks sequence length, quality scores, etc.

say_en.text: Explore experiment_results.csv, list missing values and outliers
say_en.note: It outputs table statistics and findings.

say_en.text: Analyze dimensions and channel info of cells.nd2
say_en.note: It reads microscopy metadata and produces a report.
